contract.qualification: Manual source-fact/legibility review before timing; actual final PNG dimensions, opacity, fit and stable pixels enforced on every call.
contract.selection: Fixed list of short structural examples from the pinned DaveBench corpus; covers flowcharts, sequences, classes, states, ER and mindmaps, plus a collapsed-subgraph negative control. Source/fact manifest frozen before v2 timing; never claims full-corpus or holdout performance.
contract.scope: Warm repeated fixed-PNG exports. Browser peers share Chromium and one SVG-to-PNG implementation. Native public renderToPng plus required fixed-canvas normalization is charged inside its timer.
contract.typography: Inter requested through public APIs, base size14; public per-role defaults are permitted if legible. Actual role sizes/families are retained; this is not typography-identical renderer throughput.
